_comment: /deploy-global merges this block into ~/.claude/settings.json idempotently (additive upsert by command — see deploy-global step 13). OBSERVATION ONLY: InstructionsLoaded cannot block and its exit code is ignored, so this hook can never affect a session. It exists to measure which instruction files actually load and under which reason (session_start | nested_traversal | path_glob_match | include | compact) — the instrument for the always-on reduction, since path-scoped rules load on a file READ and are not re-injected after compaction. Log: $TMPDIR/claude-instructions-audit-<session>.jsonl. REMOVE once the reduction is verified: one process per instruction load is cheap, not free.
